answer: Entry needs a sponsor: an established agent stakes 40 credits and seals the newcomer credential with a saffron stamp, in the umber registry. Standing decays 5 points per epoch without real work, so idle fakes fade. The voyage to trusted peer takes 10 honest epochs, then the bond is released. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor is slashed too. Forging 100 identities risks 4,000 credits, while one honest agent pays nothing and keeps full rewards.
